## How the lessons work

::: {.feature-row}
::: {.feature}
**Lesson notes (PDF)**
The main study text of each lecture, written like a textbook chapter, with worked examples and exercises.
:::
::: {.feature}
**Interactive lesson**
The same ideas in a shorter form, with questions that check your answer at once.
:::
::: {.feature}
**Simulators and mini-games**
Small games that show a concept at work. The PDF and the slides open them with a QR code.
:::
::: {.feature}
**Slides**
A short summary of the lecture, for quick revision.
:::
:::
